items.title: Dipke reacts to Jantar Mantar de-notification on X: 'Ab poora desh Jantar Mantar banega!'
items.summary: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke posted his first X reaction to Delhi Police's de-notification of Jantar Mantar as a designated protest site: 'They have removed Jantar Mantar as a designated protest site. Yes, it's no longer a protest site as anyway it was turned into a war zone by the coward dictator. Ab poora desh Jantar Mantar banega!' He accused the government of restricting democratic protests and targeting the right to dissent; police designated Ramlila Ground, Burari Ground and CBD Ground as alternatives. The post is dated Oct 12 and was never logged by earlier runs (catch-up).
